```sh
kafka config list-resources
```

List every config resource the broker knows about

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Lists supported config resources known to the broker.

## Flags

| Flag                           | Description                                                   |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`           | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092              |
| `--type <string> (repeatable)` | limit to this resource type (repeatable, default: every type) |

## Examples

```sh
kafka config list-resources --brokers localhost:9092
kafka config list-resources --type topic --type group
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "resources": []
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
